section_summary.extract_value: Study X describes an experiment with 165 female university students randomly assigned to a 2 (appearance vs. health) × 2 (no guilt vs. guilt) between-subjects design, recruited via a university participation pool. Participants attended in-person group testing sessions, completed a packet of materials (20–35 min), and were exposed to manipulations of article framing (appearance vs. health) and guilt in a short passage; the sample was predominantly white (77.7%), mean age 19.44 (SD = 1.40), and mean BMI 21.31 (SD = 3.59).
